title: Foreign Minister Roberto Velasco Prepares Official Visit to China
author: Arturo Sánchez Jiménez
content:
_This article by[Arturo Sánchez
Jiménez](https://www.jornada.com.mx/autores/Arturo%20S%C3%A1nchez%20Jim%C3%A9nez)
originally appeared in the [September 2, 2026 edition of La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/09/02/politica/canciller-
roberto-velasco-alista-visita-oficial-a-china), Mexico's premier left wing
daily newspaper._

**Mexico City**. Foreign Affairs Secretary Roberto Velasco Álvarez **will make
a working visit to the People 's Republic of China on September 7**, the
Foreign Affairs Ministry (SRE) reported on Wednesday through its account on
the social network X.

During his stay, the foreign minister will hold a meeting with his Chinese
counterpart, Foreign Minister Wang Yi. As part of his agenda, Velasco **will
also inaugurate the Consulate of Mexico in the city of Chongqing**.

> [The visit] will make it possible to strengthen the political dialogue and
> the cooperation agenda between the two countries.
>
> Foreign Affairs Ministry (SRE)

The trip adds to previous meetings between representatives of the two foreign
ministries. In May 2025, within the framework of the Fourth Ministerial
Meeting of the CELAC-China Forum, then foreign minister Juan Ramón de la
Fuente met with Wang Yi, an occasion on which both officials highlighted the
relationship of respect between Mexico and China and the shared interest in
strengthening bilateral cooperation.

It will be Velasco's **second trip to Asia in recent weeks** , as he visited
South Korea from August 23 to 25.
